title: teucrium sieberi var. hirtum
intro: Teucrium sieberi var. hirtum, commonly known as Alpine Germander, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae, native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean. The health benefits of Alpine Germander include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Teucrium sieberi var. hirtum are attributed to its ability to inhibit histamine release, thus acting as an antihistamine, and its antimicrobial effects, making it useful in treating various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Germander include iridoid glycosides, diterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
